settings.custom_liquid: {{ 'aljarah-maison.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}<style>.utility-bar .announcement-bar-slider.slider-buttons{display:flex!important;}.ap-pay{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem;list-style:none;margin:1.6rem 0 0;padding:0}.ap-pay svg{display:block;width:3.8rem;height:2.4rem}</style><script src="{{ 'ap-cart.js' | asset_url }}" defer></script>{%- paginate collections.all.products by 250 -%}<script>window.apColors={ {%- for p in collections.all.products -%}{%- assign apc = p.options_with_values | where: 'name', 'Color' | first -%}{%- if apc and apc.values.size > 1 -%}{{ p.handle | json }}:{{ apc.values.size }},{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%} };</script>{%- endpaginate -%}<style>.ap-cc{margin:.4rem 0 0;font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(var(--color-foreground),.6)}</style><script>(function(){function r(){document.querySelectorAll('.card-information').forEach(function(i){if(i.querySelector('.ap-cc'))return;var w=i.closest('.card__information');var a=w&&w.querySelector('.card__heading a[href*="/products/"]');if(!a)return;var h=a.getAttribute('href').split('?')[0].split('/products/')[1];var n=window.apColors&&window.apColors[h];if(!n)return;var p=document.createElement('p');p.className='ap-cc';p.textContent=n+' colores';i.appendChild(p);});}document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){r();new MutationObserver(function(){r();}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});});})();</script>
